countersubjects.notes: after first falling steps becomes fourfold repetition of a three-note figure in rising sequence; absent from bar 23 onward

claims.claim: Between episodes 2 and 3 there are nine subject entries (ten counting the partial one at 24) with little or no connecting matter
Alto counterpoint at bar 7 is not a second countersubject but important for later development
Countersubject is absent from bar 23 and does not reappear
The coda has simultaneous direct and inverted subject entries (soprano and tenor)
